public_note: Compact IA source/provenance witness for Noether Paper 33 printed pp.071-073. Source support only, not a corrected TeX branch or critical edition.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 33 compact IA source/provenance witness
files.coverage: Noether Paper 33, `Hyperkomplexe Größen und Darstellungstheorie in arithmetischer Auffassung`, `Atti del congresso internazionale dei matematici`, Bologna, Volume 2, source/printed pp.071-073. The package includes the IA source PDF, IA scandata/metadata/file XML, IA OCR/DJVU locator text/XML, a source slice PDF derived from original IA JP2 leaves, the three valid extracted original JP2 leaves, JPG render witnesses for each page, an explicit page/leaf map, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The local sweep found the source-master folder and valid original JP2 leaves for printed pp.071-073. Zero-byte failed direct JP2 download attempts and the full 558 MB IA original-JP2 tar were excluded from the compact package. OCR is retained only as a locator aid; source page images control readings.
files.limitations: Source/provenance support only. Not a corrected TeX branch, translation, full Paper 33 certification, critical edition, or multilingual propagation.
files.next_action: Upload with the next Noether source-audit/provenance Zenodo version if retained, then update record IDs, metadata JSON, public file catalog, generated record pages, and status docs. Use this witness for later Paper 33 source comparison and branch reconciliation.
